verdict.rationale: The Department of State offers a public 'Search Corporations and Business Entities' database showing whether an entity is currently active or inactive, and a public license-record search. This lets a founder confirm a completed filing produced an entity and check its status. There is no evidence of a public tracker for in-process filing, application, or case status; post-filing updates come by email acknowledgement rather than a public page. Missing for 10: public in-progress filing/application status lookup, case/complaint status lookup, hands-on corroboration of the entity search.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: (7) whether the entity is currently active or inactive.
